criteria.reason: The keyboard row contains Copy Last, Done, and Next buttons.
Done uses flex: 2 beside two flex: 1 buttons, so it is narrower than the full row.
All three buttons have a 48px height, exceeding the 44px minimum.
Copy Last uses the previous value supplied for the active field and updates the display and value.
Next switches the keypad state to reps, but the keypad’s internal display is not synchronized with the new value, so the reps value may not appear.
The buttons use design tokens for colors and border radius.
The actions share a flexible row that fits the existing keypad layout on mobile.
The button labels contain no exclamation marks or hype.
The harness reports all 197 server and 291 client tests passing.
A new test checks that Copy Last calls onChange with the previous value and updates the display.
